_doc: ADR-551 · Resource guardrails. The ONE policy for disk/memory thresholds, process classes, heavy-job admission and allow-listed cleanup. Read by spa_core/monitoring/resource_guard.py and spa_core/utils/heavy_job.py. Changing a number here is a reviewed commit, not a runtime knob. Canonical, git-tracked; nothing here is a financial or risk limit.

disk._why: Measured 2026-10-02/03: the Data volume reached 0 bytes twice (ENOSPC 22:58-23:03Z and 07:55-08:05Z) from ~87 GB of abandoned test stands plus parallel worktrees; nothing in the fleet asked «is there room to write». 40 GB leaves a day of the worst measured growth (~30 GB/day); 15 GB still lets the alert itself be written. The reserve file is released at CRITICAL so canonical writers (paper books, atomic_save) keep room while the cause is found.

memory._why: kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level: 1 normal, 2 warn, 4 critical (the kernel's own grading, not ours). Swap on this Mac is 3 x 1 GB files; the previous Claude session's wait loops were killed under low memory on 2026-10-02/03.

CRITICAL._why: Derived from dependencies: the paper books (hy/lp sleeves, the daily Conservative cycle) are the canonical writers the package status read model reads (spa_core/defi_engine/package_status.py); the site and Director read that model through the API (com.spa.apiserver) behind the tunnel (com.spa.cloudflared). A lost run here is a lost observation that cannot be backfilled.

IMPORTANT._why: Owner surfaces (Director, Telegram), the backup that keeps evidence off-host, Trading Research (must not break), the health and resource monitors themselves, and the autonomous build loop runner (its CHILDREN are disposable, the scheduler is not). RTMR sense loop (ADR-053) feeds the Conservative book's FREEZE reaction.

DISPOSABLE._why: Test shards, headless LLM runs, browser verification and anything executing from a disposable /tmp worktree. They may be slowed (nice) under pressure; they are never killed by the guard.

heavy_jobs._why: docs/audits/p0-ci-resource-admission.md: two concurrent full runs drove free memory to 0.1 GB and six jobs were killed. A full suite takes a lease; a third waits; the same tree is never claimed by two live jobs.

disposable_dirs._why: mkdtemp stands of measurement tools and tests (ADR-546: 957 g17_/g18_ dirs, 87 GB). Created by code, never canonical.
Test backup stands (spa_test_backups_*). Headless-browser profiles were dropped from the list: a short prefix (vpsys…) could match another tool's directory (review 2026-10-03).

worktrees._why: Linked git worktrees are removed ONLY by the existing reaper: idle >= 24 h, every changed path delivered/superseded, archived to ~/SPA_backups/worktree_reap before removal; anything unproven stays.
